title: VooPoo Argus PNP-X Empty Replacement Pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: The Voopoo Argus PNP X Replacement Pod is designed to enhance your vaping experience with the Voopoo Argus E40 Kit. This 2ml pod is compatible with all of Voopoo’s celebrated PNP X coils, offering a wide range of resistance options to suit MTL (mouth-to-lung), DTL (direct-to-lung) and even RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. The pod features a convenient side-fill system, making refilling quick and mess-free. The durable construction and snug fit ensure no leakage and consistent performance. Whether you prefer high VG, high PG, 50/50 or Nic Salt e-liquids, the Argus PNP X pod delivers exceptional flavour and vapour production every time.
